title: Flow layout
description:
Place tags on lines, wrapping when the next one does not fit, like `SameLine` with wrapping.

```
width 120, spacing 8
line 1: [player 50] [enemy 45]
line 2: [boss 35] [npc 30] [item 30]
line 3: [very long tag name 110]
```
hints: Keep `x` and `y`; before placing, `if (x > 0 && x + item.width > width) { x = 0; y += 20; }` (lesson 3.01).
requirements: Items have a width; put each after the previous one plus spacing, or start a new line if it would pass the width.
An item wider than the whole width goes on its own line.
Return the (x, y) of every item; each line is 20 pixels tall.
stretch: Centre each line inside the width.
